title: ITC Faculty Early Bird Programme
institution: University of Twente, Faculty of Geo-Information Science and Earth Observation (ITC)
field: Geo-information science and earth observation; spatial systems
about: The University of Twente's ITC Faculty runs the Early Bird Programme for students unconditionally admitted to its MSc Geo-Information Science and Earth Observation or MSc Spatial Systems & Society, starting September 2027. The single, strict application deadline is 31 January 2027.
requirements: Unconditional admission to the MSc Geo-Information Science and Earth Observation or the MSc Spatial Systems & Society
